description: Camera presence, vocal delivery, storytelling through uncertainty, communication clarity

principles.rule: The biggest mistake across small creators is CONFUSION — you have full context, the viewer has zero
principles.implication: Revisit every part ~100 times to find any way to make it easier to understand. Have someone else watch before posting.

principles.rule: Intrigue comes from uncertainty — the key to turning boring videos into captivating stories
principles.implication: Establish danger, inexperience, and potential failure to make even mundane sequences compelling.

principles.rule: Whatever emotion you put into your voice is contagious
principles.implication: Vocal delivery is as important as the words. Monotone kills even great scripts.

principles.rule: Every single thing discussed should have an accompanying visual
principles.implication: Zoom/pan to exactly what the viewer should look at. Never leave them guessing what to focus on.

three_part_litmus_test.description: Ryan Trahan's test for every scene — if any answer is 'no', fix or cut the scene

questions.question: Does the viewer know what is happening?
Do they know why it is important?
Do they know what could go wrong?

three_part_litmus_test.rule: If you cannot create curiosity/expectations for a scene, cut it out or summarize with a single voiceover sentence

vocal_delivery.description: Voice techniques that make content sound important and engaging

techniques.description: Speak louder to convey excitement or urgency
Lower your voice to create suspense and draw the listener in
Pause before big reveals to build anticipation
Speed up for excitement, slow down for gravity

vocal_delivery.automation_hint: Map to voice_generator.py emotion registers: neutral (measured), tense (lower, slower), energized (louder, faster)

physical_presence.description: Body language cues for talking-head or presentation videos
techniques: Head movement synced with word emphasis
Hand gestures to separate ideas visually
physical_presence.note: Not directly applicable to documentary style, but relevant for any future face-to-camera content

communication_clarity.description: Making abstract ideas tangible and easy to understand

techniques.description: Turn abstract ideas into vivid, tangible concepts
techniques.example: The Water Tank analogy for viewer interest

techniques.description: Always follow a principle with a concrete example
techniques.rule: Never state a rule without showing it in action

techniques.description: Every single thing discussed should have an accompanying visual. Zoom/pan to exactly what the viewer should look at.
techniques.automation_hint: Storyboard must have a visual for every narration segment. No 'blank' moments.

techniques.description: Assume the viewer has ZERO context. No jargon without explanation. No assumed knowledge.
techniques.automation_hint: Script QA should flag domain-specific terms without explanation.

camera_shyness_fix.description: Treat the camera like a close friend who is interested in what you're saying
camera_shyness_fix.mindset: Focus on sharing the message, not on performing perfectly. Allow mistakes — they can be cut. Authentic excitement beats flawless monotone.

algorithm_strategy.description: The algorithm is simple: if people click and watch, it promotes more
algorithm_strategy.implication: Success = make videos people click on AND watch, better than everyone else. Study what gets the most views in your niche, determine what your audience values, then provide that value better.

retention_score.description: Score a video's retention potential before publishing

criteria.name: litmus_test_pass
criteria.description: Does every scene pass the 3-question litmus test?

criteria.name: zero_confusion
criteria.description: Would a first-time viewer understand everything?

criteria.name: visual_coverage
criteria.description: Does every narration segment have an accompanying visual?

criteria.name: vocal_variation
criteria.description: Does vocal delivery vary (volume, pace, pitch) across sections?

criteria.name: uncertainty_present
criteria.description: Is there uncertainty/tension driving the viewer forward?

criteria.name: analogies_examples
criteria.description: Are abstract concepts explained with analogies or examples?

anti_patterns.mistake: Assuming the viewer has context you have
anti_patterns.consequence: Confusion — and confusion kills everything. Viewers leave immediately.
anti_patterns.fix: Have someone else watch. They will ALWAYS find confusing or boring moments.

anti_patterns.mistake: Monotone vocal delivery regardless of content
anti_patterns.consequence: Even important revelations fall flat. Viewer disengages.
anti_patterns.fix: Vary volume, pace, and pitch. Louder for excitement, lower for suspense, pause for anticipation.

anti_patterns.consequence: Viewer's eyes wander. They check their phone. Attention lost.
anti_patterns.fix: Every single thing discussed must have an accompanying visual.

anti_patterns.mistake: Scenes that lack purpose or curiosity
anti_patterns.consequence: Dead weight that trains viewers to expect boredom
anti_patterns.fix: Apply 3-question litmus test. If it fails, cut or summarize in one sentence.
